bounded.label: Bounded
bounded.description: Watch only within an explicit time window. Track segment opens at first sighting in the window and closes when the window ends or the entity reaches a terminal state.
bounded.example: Find flight ABC123 on 2026-04-10. Segment opens at first ADS-B return, closes when the flight lands or 2026-04-11 begins.

persistent.label: Persistent
persistent.description: Watch indefinitely. Segments are opened and closed by idle gaps; the watch itself never closes until manually deactivated.
persistent.example: Tail number N12345 — watch forever. New segment after each 24h idle gap. Watch persists across years.

conditional.label: Conditional
conditional.description: Watch is always armed but only opens a segment when a specific condition is met. Segment closes when the condition stops being met.
conditional.example: Vessel MV-X — only when entering EEZ. Segment opens at boundary crossing, closes at exit. Watch persists indefinitely.

content._default_doc: When a watch is created without an explicit mode, default to persistent with the default 24h idle gap. This is the safest assumption: the user said 'watch this' without further qualification, so we keep watching.
